name: Today Tomorrow Never
source:
Kyo suffers from dementia and tries to live like an ordinary person. His memory is constantly failing, and he forgets everything. However, everything changes when he meets his former classmate...

And what is the mystery of the alley?

Did I mention that Kyo has dementia?

Wait, why do these two white-haired guys look so much like each other?

It doesn't matter...

[From [url=https://cyborg-cant-eat-pizza.itch.io/today-tomorrow-never]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
京患有痴呆症，努力像普通人一样生活。他的记忆力不断衰退，什么都忘记了。然而，当他遇到了昔日的同学时，一切都发生了变化……

而这条胡同到底有何玄机呢？

我有没有提到京患有痴呆症？

等等，这两个白发男子怎么长得这么像？

没关系…
